question: What is the tone of the passage?
solution: The correct answer is **Option (1).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage has a reflective tone, especially when the author discusses the challenge of unlearning preconceived notions and shares a personal experience. (Paragraphs 1, 2, and 3) • The anecdote and **discussion prompt readers to reflect on their own beliefs** and the process of unlearning. (Paragraphs 2 and 3) **Therefore, the correct answer is "Reflective".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Option (2) **does not align with the passage's introspective nature. • **Option (3),** while the anecdote could be seen as light-hearted, doesn't define the overall tone. • **Option (4)** could be a secondary aspect but doesn't capture the primary tone as well as reflective does. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** • **Reflective** - Showing deep thought or consideration. (गहन विचार या विचारणा दर्शाना।) • **Sarcastic** - Marked by or given to using irony in order to mock or convey contempt. (व्यंग्यात्मक - उपहास करने या तिरस्कार प्रकट करने के लिए विडंबना का उपयोग करने की विशेषता वाला।) • **Humorous** - Characterized by humor; funny. (हास्यजनक - हास्य द्वारा वर्णित; मजेदार।) • **Humanistic **- Focused on human values and concerns. (मानवतावादी - मानव मूल्यों और चिंताओं पर केंद्रित।) 96:T83b, The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. **"Alleviate".**
